tasks.label: Build & Run aktuelle ASM-Datei (lokal)
tasks.command: .\nasm.exe -f win64 "${fileBasenameNoExtension}.asm" -o "${fileBasenameNoExtension}.obj"; if ($?) { .\GoLink.exe /entry start /fo "${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" "${fileBasenameNoExtension}.obj" kernel32.dll user32.dll gdi32.dll winmm.dll comdlg32.dll }; if ($?) { (Get-Item "${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe").Length; & ".\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" }
